regexes `word.ext` tokens out of reviewer prose to decide a repeated complaint points outside the write scope, which is what makes deadlock_reason terminal

clears an environment failure when a changed file's stem appears anywhere in the traceback (a third-party ModuleNotFoundError raised while importing that file); nop then scores red-as-intended and TDD passes on a suite that never ran

drops a finding of any severity whose body mentions rate limiting/throttling/DoS; a critical auth-bypass finding worded with `no rate limit` stops blocking; JSON findings are re-parsed through the same filter

the stories machine gate rejects any criterion matching `\bTODO\b` (also stub, placeholder, no-op) — every to-do application, including this framework's dogfood corpora, fails plan approval

F3-STRUCTURED-JUDGMENT-AUTHORITY.statement: `not resolved`, `unresolved`, `will be fixed` contain a RESOLVED marker, so an open P0/P1 onboarding blocker counts as done in a release gate
one prose line in EXPERIENCE.md (`Screens: none … API only for now`) marks every UI verification kind NOT_APPLICABLE
the still-green criteria list is data at the producer and is re-derived from a sentence at the consumer; rewording disables the deadlock diagnosis silently
A blocking gate decision can rest on the model reviewer alone
F3-STRUCTURED-JUDGMENT-AUTHORITY.disposition: SUPERSEDED by INV-F.2 + the binding rule (F3): a judge-only block must bind to a file, a behaviour id or a criterion code of THIS candidate (`Verdict.bound_blocking`); an unbound blocker is recorded as `review:unbound` and never scored, and a verdict whose blockers all bind to nothing is REVIEW_UNRUNNABLE after one reminder — never a PASS, never a developer session. Owner ruling 1's four properties (identifiable in evidence, distinguishable from deterministic blocking, human escape path, cannot masquerade as deterministic) keep holding; this adds the fifth, structural one. The judge-only block RATE stays a measured, published property of the framework, not a defect: G2.4b owns it. Evidence: tests/hardening/test_judgment.py; closure-evidence/hardening/judge-only-audit-f3.json (re-run on the same corpus).
